name: Cassandra's Fabulous Foray
source:
"Welcome, peasants to my fabulous story!" Cassandra exclaims. Watch and guide Her Grace, Cassandra Dawnstrider, 3rd Baroness and Grand Magistrix of New Haven in a western-themed fantasy visual novel. Help Cassandra defeat the evil villains Slippity Jim and the pompous Duke von Hohenstaufen as they try to bring law and order to the village of Malapais. With several branching endings, turn-based battles, and many opportunities to fail, can the daring Baroness survive?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/688200/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“欢迎农民们听我的神话故事！”卡桑德拉惊呼道。在这部西部主题的奇幻视觉小说中，观看并引导女王陛下、卡桑德拉·黎明行者、第三代男爵夫人和纽黑文的大魔导师。帮助卡桑德拉击败邪恶的恶棍滑溜吉姆和傲慢的冯·霍恩施陶芬公爵，因为他们试图为马拉佩斯村带来法律和秩序。多个分支结局、回合制战斗和许多失败的机会，勇敢的男爵夫人能生存下来吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/688200/]Steam[/url]]
